# KI Construction Materials Importer

> KI Construction Materials Importer (KI Construction) is an importer, exporter and distributor of construction and industrial machinery based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. It supplies diesel generators (20–250 kVA), water and solar pumps (1–100 HP), hydraulic breakers, construction machinery and spare parts, and HDPE/GI pipe fittings and valves to projects across Ethiopia. KI is the exclusive agent in Ethiopia for Power Trader Co. (South Korea), a hydraulic breaker manufacturer.

Key facts:

- Founded and registered in 2006 E.C. (2013 G.C.) by Engineer Kedir Ibrahim Beker, Founder and Managing Director, who has 23 years of experience in construction and industrial machinery.
- 150+ major projects supported across construction, agriculture, water supply and industry.
- Brands supplied: Perkins, Cummins and Güçbir generators; SANY, XCMG and SDLG machinery; Power Trader hydraulic breakers.
- Every product comes with technical advice, installation support, spare parts and after-sales service.
- Address: Samuel Deressa Building, 4th floor, Churchill Road, Piassa, Arada Sub-City, Woreda 01, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
- Phone: +251 911 230787, +251 911 761068 (main); +251 961 222288, +251 963 222288 (sales). WhatsApp: +251 911 230787. Telegram: @Kedir_KI. Email: kiethiopia@gmail.com.
- Languages: English and Amharic.

## Products

- [Diesel generators (20–250 kVA)](https://kiconstruction.site/product-generating-sets.html): Perkins, Cummins and Güçbir silent and open-frame generating sets, installation and spare parts.
- [Hydraulic breakers](https://kiconstruction.site/product-hydraulic-breakers.html): Power Trader hydraulic breakers, attachments, chisels and spare parts — KI is the exclusive Ethiopian agent.
- [Water and solar pumps (1–100 HP)](https://kiconstruction.site/product-pumps.html): submersible, centrifugal and solar pumps for boreholes, irrigation and water supply.
- [Construction machinery](https://kiconstruction.site/product-construction-machinery.html): SANY, XCMG and SDLG wheel loaders, dump trucks, block machines and spare parts.
- [Pipe fittings and valves](https://kiconstruction.site/product-electro-mechanical.html): HDPE and GI pipe fittings, valves, flanges and adaptors for water, irrigation and industrial projects.
- [All products](https://kiconstruction.site/products.html)
